items.sow_notes: Start indoors ~8 wks before transplant (late March in Zone 5b). Johnny's pepper culture: sow 1/4 in deep; hold soil 80-90F for germination (very slow in cool soil). Pot up at first true leaves; grow 70F day / 60F night. Optional cold treatment at 3rd true leaf (53-55F nights x4 wks) increases early set. Transplant out only after frost has passed and soil is warm - ideal transplants have buds but no open flowers. Space 12-18 in apart, rows 24-36 in. Black plastic mulch + lightweight fabric row cover buffers cold and adds earliness (remove above 85F to prevent blossom drop). Control cutworms (Bt/collars) and tarnished plant bug/aphid/flea beetle (pyrethrin). Prevent bacterial spot & Phytophthora with drip irrigation, well-drained soil, low compaction, 4-yr rotation. Pick first pods promptly to push set. All Johnny's pepper lots bacterial-spot tested. Packet 25 seeds; ~60,000 seeds/lb. F1 hybrid.
